_readme: LOCAL-ONLY override of config/platforms.json for PLAN 11.1c browser testing (docs/embedding/obi-embed-local-test-keys.md). Point BOTH apps at this file via the PLATFORMS_PATH env var (backend: backend/.env or shell; frontend: frontend/.env.local) rather than merging it into the committed real-platform registry. Issuer/jwks keys here are throwaway test-mews/test-toast/test-opera/test-none entries served by this SAME Next.js app's own /api/test-hosts and /.well-known routes -- not real third parties. The 'integrations' map keys are the JWT 'integration' CLAIM VALUES the test-host token routes issue (mews/toast/opera-cloud), NOT the 'platforms' dict keys above them (test-mews/test-toast/test-opera/test-none) -- PlatformRegistry.scopes_for() looks up by the verified claim value, matching the real committed config/platforms.json's own convention. Never commit a real secret here (there is none -- only public test issuer metadata; the matching private keys live in frontend/.env.local, gitignored).
